xml_snippets.Title: NoInteraction (SlaveInteractionModeDef)
xml_snippets.Label: no interaction
xml_snippets.Description Originale: Wardens will not interact with this slave.
xml_snippets.XML:
<SlaveInteractionModeDef>

    <defName>NoInteraction</defName>

    <label>no interaction</label>

    <listOrder>0</listOrder>

    <description>Wardens will not interact with this slave.</description>

  </SlaveInteractionModeDef>

xml_snippets.Title: Suppress (SlaveInteractionModeDef)
xml_snippets.Label: suppress
xml_snippets.Description Originale: Wardens will periodically intimidate the slave to increase their suppression level and reduce the chance of rebellion.
xml_snippets.XML:
<SlaveInteractionModeDef>

    <defName>Suppress</defName>

    <label>suppress</label>

    <listOrder>10</listOrder>

    <description>Wardens will periodically intimidate the slave to increase their suppression level and reduce the chance of rebellion.</description>

  </SlaveInteractionModeDef>
